stories.story_fr: Au T3 2025, The Hartford a relevé son dividende trimestriel par action de 15%, à 0,60 $, payable le 5 janvier 2026, en parallèle de résultats de base record de 1,1 Md$ et d'un ROE de base sur 12 mois glissants de 18,4%.
stories.story_en: In Q3 2025, The Hartford increased its quarterly common dividend per share by 15%, to $0.60, alongside record core earnings of $1.1 billion and a trailing 12-month core earnings ROE of 18.4%.
stories.signal: Increased the quarterly common dividend per share by 15%, to $0.60, payable Jan. 5, 2026 to shareholders of record at the close of business on Dec. 1, 2025.

stories.story_fr: Le T1 2025 a été marqué par des pertes catastrophes P&C de 467 M$ avant impôt, dont 325 M$ liés à l'événement des incendies de Californie de janvier 2025, net de réassurance, pesant sur le ratio combiné Personal Insurance à 106,1.
stories.story_en: Q1 2025 was hit by P&C catastrophe losses of $467 million before tax, including $325 million from the January 2025 California Wildfire Event net of reinsurance, pushing the Personal Insurance combined ratio to 106.1.
stories.signal: P C current accident year (CAY) catastrophe (CAT) losses in first quarter 2025 of $467 million, before tax, including losses related to the January 2025 California Wildfire Event of $325 million, net of reinsurance.

stories.story_fr: The Hartford a clôturé 2025 avec un bénéfice net annuel de 3,8 Mds$ (+23%) et un T4 exceptionnel de 1,1 Md$ (+33%), portés par une croissance des primes P&C de 7% sur l'année et un ROE net annuel de 22,0%.
stories.story_en: The Hartford closed 2025 with full-year net income of $3.8 billion (+23%) and an outstanding Q4 of $1.1 billion (+33%), driven by 7% full-year P&C premium growth and a 22.0% full-year net income ROE.
stories.signal: The Hartford Reports Outstanding Fourth Quarter Earnings Of $1.1 Billion And Full Year 2025 Earnings Of $3.8 Billion
